Description: Unique identifier for included water systems
Source(s): California (CA) Public Drinking Water Watch (PDWW) Safe Drinking Water Information System, USEPA Enforcement and Compliance History Online (ECHO)

Description: Whether the system (1) is operated by a carceral facility and exists to primarily or exclusively serve that facility (or facilities) (i.e. carceral water systems), (2) provides service to one or more carceral facilities but is operated by an independent provider and serves other customers/populations in addition to the carceral facility (i.e., carceral-serving water systems), or (3) does not meet either of those criteria (i.e., other water systems)
Source(s): Homeland Infrastructure Foundation Level Data (HIFLD) “Prison Boundaries” database, CA Drinking Water System Area Boundaries (CA State Geoportal), publicly-available online information (e.g., Consumer Confidence Reports [CCRs], carceral facility documents), 2023 California Community Water System Institutional Type Update, CA PDWW, USEPA ECHO
Derivation method: Assigned using a spatial intersection of open HIFLD carceral facilities and water system service area boundaries, which was further refined using manual review of publicly available online information (e.g. CCRs) for facilities that did not intersect with any water system and facilities that intersected with multiple water systems. Carceral water systems and carceral-serving water systems were distinguished based on the 2023 CA Community Water System Institutional Type Update and further manual review of the list of potentially partially carceral-serving water systems to determine if the system may be owned or operated by the facility, based on system name and contact.

Description: California state classification for water system type
Allowed values: C (community water system) | NTNC (Non-transient non-community water system)

Description: Whether the system's primary water source is groundwater or surface water
Derivation method: Assigned "GW" if the CA PDSS source type was listed as GU (groundwater under the direct influence of surface water), GUP (purchased groundwaer under the direct influence of surface water), GW (groundwater), or GWP (purchased groundwater); otherwise, assigned "SW"

Assigned "purchased" if the CA PDWW source type was listed as GUP (purchased groundwater under the direct influence of surface water), GWP (purchased groundwater), or SWP (purchased surface water); otherwise assigned "not purchased"

Description: The principal hydrologic region in which the system is located
Allowed values: Central Coast | Colorado River | North Coast | North Lahontan | Sacramento River | San Francisco Bay | San Joaquin River | South Coast | South Lahontan | Tulare Lake
Null value: NA - used for any systems that lacked spatial data in the CA Drinking Water System Area Boundaries, and for systems whose service area boundaries did not intersect with CA DWR hydrologic regions
Source(s): CA Drinking Water System Area Boundaries (CA State Geoportal), CA Department of Water Resources Hydrologic Region Boundaries
Derivation method: Assigned via spatial intersection to the hydrologic region with the greatest spatial overlap with the system

Description: Whether the centroid of the system is located greater than 5 miles from an urban area containing at least 5,000 people or at least 2,000 housing units
Null value: NA - used for any systems that lacked spatial data in the CA Drinking Water System Area Boundaries
Source(s): CA Drinking Water System Area Boundaries (CA State Geoportal), CalTrans urbanized areas list
Derivation method: Calculated the distance from the centroid of each system to the nearest urban area containing at least 5,000 people or at least 2,000 housing units

Description: Whether the centroid of the system is located greater than 5 miles from a 50,000-person urban area
Null value: NA - used for any systems that lacked spatial data in the CA Drinking Water System Area Boundaries
Source(s): CA Drinking Water System Area Boundaries (CA State Geoportal), CalTrans urbanized areas list
Derivation method: Calculated the distance from the centroid of each system to the nearest 5,000-person urban area

Description: Whether the system had one or more health-based violation(s) from 2020-2024
Source(s): CSWRCB Drinking Water Program Annual Compliance Reports
Derivation method: Calculated whether each system had health-based violations (i.e., Maximum Contaminant Level or Treatment Technique) during the most recent five-year period for which data were available (2020-2024)

Description: Whether the system had one or more monitoring violation(s) from 2020-2024
Source(s): CSWRCB Drinking Water Program Annual Compliance Reports
Derivation method: Calculated whether each system had monitoring violations during the most recent five-year period for which data were available (2020-2024)

Description: The system's assigned risk level for water quality in the 2025 Needs Assessment
Allowed values: High to medium risk | Low to no risk | Not Assessed
Null value: Not asssessed - used for systems that were not assessed in the CA SWRCB 2025 Needs Assessment
Source(s): California State Water Resources Control Board's 2025 Needs Assessment
Derivation method: Dichotomized as high-to-medium and low-to-no risk

Description: The system's assigned risk level for water accessibility in the 2025 Needs Assessment
Allowed values: High to medium risk | Low to no risk | Not Assessed
Null value: Not asssessed - used for systems that were not assessed in the CA SWRCB 2025 Needs Assessment
Source(s): California State Water Resources Control Board's 2025 Needs Assessment
Derivation method: Dichotomized as high-to-medium and low-to-no risk

Description: The system's assigned risk level for Technical, Managerial, and Financial (TMF) capacity in the 2025 Needs Assessment
Allowed values: High to medium risk | Low to no risk | Not Assessed
Null value: Not asssessed - used for systems that were not assessed in the CA SWRCB 2025 Needs Assessment
Source(s): California State Water Resources Control Board's 2025 Needs Assessment
Derivation method: Dichotomized as high-to-medium and low-to-no risk

Description: The system's overall risk assessment status in the 2025 Needs Assessment
Allowed values: Failing | At-Risk | Potentially At-Risk | Not At-Risk | Not Assessed
Null value: Not asssessed - used for systems that were not assessed in the CA SWRCB 2025 Needs Assessment
Source(s): California State Water Resources Control Board's 2025 Needs Assessment

Description: Whether the system was missing one or more Consumer Confidence Reports from 2020-2023
Derivation method: CCRs downloaded from CA SDWIS as PDF, xlsx, and word files, and used to calculate whether the system was missing one or more CCRs during from 2020-2023

Description: The supervising regulatory agency responsible for the system
Allowed values: 54 California Division of Drinking Water districts or LPAs (local primacy agencies)
Null value: NA - used for any systems that lacked spatial data via the CA SWRCB service area boundaries tool, and for systems whose service area boundaries did not intersect with the regulatory agencies analyzed
Source(s): CA Drinking Water System Area Boundaries (CA State Geoportal)
